about: Cases every lettering reader runs: tests/test_lettering_cases.py in the backend and cases.test.ts beside this file. Paths are relative to this file. A catalog case reads its catalog with the listed changes applied and the listed text edits made to the canonical bytes; reason is null when every reader accepts it, and otherwise the one reason every reader refuses it for. A layout case lays its text out and must give the recorded placements, or refuse for the recorded reason. A glyph case pins the rings in millimetres at a cap height. Generated by scripts/generate_lettering_cases.py; do not edit by hand.
